description: This file contains API service functions for a web UI, including data fetching, mock data generation, and API interaction logic for various system components like WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, NTP, DDNS, QoS, and system status.

methods.name: getWanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WAN status, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getLanStatus
methods.description: Fetches LAN status, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getWlanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WLAN status, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Fetches system statistics, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi neighbor info, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: scanWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Scans for Wi-Fi neighbors on specified band, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs fetch request.

methods.name: getLcmStatus
methods.description: Retrieves LCM status, returns mock data with random deployment units in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getNtpSettings
methods.description: Fetches NTP settings, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateNtpSettings
methods.description: Updates NTP settings, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs POST request.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Fetches timezone data, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateTimezone
methods.description: Updates timezone data, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs POST request.

methods.name: getDdns
methods.description: Fetches DDNS data, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateDdns
methods.description: Updates DDNS data, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs POST request.

methods.name: getDualImageStatus
methods.description: Fetches dual image status, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getQosBandwidth
methods.description: Fetches QoS bandwidth info, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateQosBandwidth
methods.description: Updates QoS bandwidth settings, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs POST request.

methods.name: getQosRule
methods.description: Fetches QoS rules, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateQosRule
methods.description: Updates QoS rules, returns mock data in development mode, otherwise performs POST request.
